Ohio Valley Family Medicine Associates 420 Chapline Street, Suite 3, Wheeling, WV 2600 Tel (304) 555-0100 Fax (304) 555-0120
April 28, 2079
To: Mr. Gilly Fenwick, Owner Gilly's Auto Salvage 1900 Water Street, Wheeling, WV
Re: Mr. Everett Hanratty, DOB 11/02/1933, employee
Dear Mr. Fenwick:
I am writing this letter on the request of my patient Mr. Hanratty, who is 45 years old and working in your yard as yard attendant. He is under my care since many years. He have a medical condition which need regular follow-up and treatment (with the patient permission, I am not give the details).
I kindly request you to allow him to attend appointment on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons for the next three months, from May 2079 until end of July 2079. He also should avoid lifting more than 20 kg for some time due to the neck problem and the high blood pressure, which is not yet well controled (BP 154/106 on 07 April 2079).
Please do the needful. If any more clarifications are needed, kindly contact me in the office.
With regards,
Vasantha Ramaswamy-Iyer, MD Family Medicine cc: patient, Corinne Hanratty Dictated 28.04.2079 Typed kdosch from 10.30.2.77
